summary: Completed testing of EduNet Special Blocks (Recreo/Almuerzo/Evento) feature. All backend API tests passed (9/9). Frontend UI tests passed - schedule grid displays correctly with horizontal view, break blocks appear as full-row yellow blocks, context menu works for adding breaks, BreakModal opens for editing with TimePicker working correctly.
passed_tests: GET /api/schedule/breaks - returns list of breaks for school
POST /api/schedule/breaks - creates Recreo break with correct type and color
POST /api/schedule/breaks - creates Almuerzo break with correct type and color
POST /api/schedule/breaks - creates Evento break with correct type and color
POST /api/schedule/breaks - overlap validation rejects overlapping breaks
PUT /api/schedule/breaks/{id} - updates break label and type
Break conflict validation - prevents class scheduling at break time
Integration test - breaks loaded alongside schedule data
Frontend: Schedule grid displays with horizontal view (time ranges as rows)
Frontend: Break blocks (Recreo) appear as full-row yellow blocks spanning all days
Frontend: Right-click context menu shows options: Recreo, Almuerzo, Evento
Frontend: Clicking on existing break opens BreakModal for editing
Frontend: TimePicker works correctly in BreakModal (shows Hora inicio/Hora fin)
Frontend: BreakModal shows type selection buttons with icons
Frontend: Settings modal opens with all configuration options
seed_data_creation: None - used existing school data. Existing Recreo break at 10:00-10:30 was used for testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Special Blocks feature fully tested. Backend endpoints: GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /api/schedule/breaks. Frontend components: CalendarGrid shows breaks as full-row colored blocks, BreakModal for add/edit with TimePicker, context menu on time slots for quick break creation. Break types: 'break' (Recreo - yellow), 'lunch' (Almuerzo - orange), 'event' (Evento - blue). Breaks prevent class scheduling at those times via conflict validation in POST /api/schedules.

validation: Break prevents new class scheduling at that time
